propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate holds Chartered Statistician (CStat) status from the Royal Statistical Society, listed as current on its public register.
propositions.rationale: The resume lists the accreditation and the recruiter verification records the register check.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate built daily item-level forecasts for 140 coffee shops with gradient-boosted models on sales history, weather and local events.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the forecasting work directly.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate agreed weighted MAPE and bias by item family as accuracy measures with supply planning and reported them every Monday.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the measures and the work sample shows a monthly accuracy report.

expectedGap: Testing and documentation of the forecasting code are not documented; the sources show only that the code was kept in a Git repository.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the register-checked CStat status and the documented forecasting, accuracy and communication work; do not extend version control into tested and documented code.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask how the forecasting code was tested and documented and what the candidate personally wrote.
